event.CommandOutput:
alice@vulnerable-server:~$ cat /home/alice/run_me.sh
#!/bin/bash

echo "Starting deployment process..."

# Pull latest code from internal Git repository using Kerberos authentication
git pull gssapi@internal-git.enterprise.local:/repos/project.git master

# Restart the project application service
systemctl restart project-app.service

echo "Deployment completed."

This script is executed regularly and automates deployment with Kerberos authentication.

Given that it is triggered via cron and restarts a service running as root, modifying this script could provide privilege escalation.
